observations.snapshot:
- main:
  - heading "Electric Vehicle Policy Assistant" [level=1]
  - paragraph: "Pilot coverage: Central, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu. Ask about one jurisdiction per question. Source verification target: 2026-09-23. Source review is pending; current availability and personal eligibility are not verified."
  - generic: Jurisdiction
  - listbox "Jurisdiction": Central
  - generic: Question
  - textbox "Question":
    - /placeholder: Ask about one vehicle category and benefit in the supplied policy documents.
    - text: According to the latest supplied amendment, what is the e-2W incentive rate and cap for 01.04.2025 to 31.03.2028? Include the price ceiling and percentage limit.
  - button "Clear"
  - button "Ask" [active]
  - heading "Answer" [level=3]
  - paragraph: "Central — source cutoff: 2026-09-23."
  - paragraph: Prototype source review is pending; current availability and individual eligibility are not verified.
  - list:
    - text: Incentive rate for registered e‑2‑wheelers for FY 01.04.2025 to 31.03.2028 is ₹2,500 per kWh of battery capacity.
    - link "S1":
      - /url: https://pmedrive.heavyindustries.gov.in/docs/policy_document/Gazette%20Notification%2010%2008%202026%20on%20enhancement%20of%20Outlay%2011900%20cr.pdf#page=3
    - text: Monetary cap per e‑2‑W vehicle is ₹5,000, i.e., the demand incentive cannot exceed this amount for any single vehicle.
    - link "S1":
      - /url: https://pmedrive.heavyindustries.gov.in/docs/policy_document/Gazette%20Notification%2010%2008%202026%20on%20enhancement%20of%20Outlay%2011900%20cr.pdf#page=3
    - text: The incentive is only available for e‑2‑W vehicles whose ex‑factory price does not exceed ₹1.5 lakh per vehicle (price ceiling).
    - link "S1":
      - /url: https://pmedrive.heavyindustries.gov.in/docs/policy_document/Gazette%20Notification%2010%2008%202026%20on%20enhancement%20of%20Outlay%2011900%20cr.pdf#page=3
    - text: Regardless of the per‑kWh rate and cap, the incentive is limited to the lower of the ₹5,000 cap or 15 % of the vehicle’s ex‑factory price.
    - link "S1":
      - /url: https://pmedrive.heavyindustries.gov.in/docs/policy_document/Gazette%20Notification%2010%2008%202026%20on%20enhancement%20of%20Outlay%2011900%20cr.pdf#page=3
  - heading "Sources" [level=3]
  - list:
    - 'link "S1: Central — Enhancement of Scheme outlay and extension of timeline for e-2Ws, PDF page 3"':
      - /url: https://pmedrive.heavyindustries.gov.in/docs/policy_document/Gazette%20Notification%2010%2008%202026%20on%20enhancement%20of%20Outlay%2011900%20cr.pdf#page=3
  - text: Examples
  - grid:
    - rowgroup:
      - row "Jurisdiction Question":
        - columnheader "Jurisdiction"
        - columnheader "Question"
    - rowgroup:
      - row "Central According to the supplied amendment, what is the e-2W incentive rate, cap, price ceiling and percentage limit?":
        - gridcell "Central":
          - generic: Central
        - gridcell "According to the supplied amendment, what is the e-2W incentive rate, cap, price ceiling and percentage limit?":
          - text: According to the supplied amendment, what is the e-2W incentive rate, cap, price ceiling and percentage limit?
          - iframe
      - row "Maharashtra What L1/L2 two-wheeler incentive percentage and per-vehicle cap does the policy state?":
        - gridcell "Maharashtra":
          - generic: Maharashtra
        - gridcell "What L1/L2 two-wheeler incentive percentage and per-vehicle cap does the policy state?":
          - text: What L1/L2 two-wheeler incentive percentage and per-vehicle cap does the policy state?
          - iframe
      - row "Tamil Nadu Which vehicles and dates are covered by the later motor vehicle tax exemption?":
        - gridcell "Tamil Nadu":
          - generic: Tamil Nadu
        - gridcell "Which vehicles and dates are covered by the later motor vehicle tax exemption?":
          - text: Which vehicles and dates are covered by the later motor vehicle tax exemption?
          - iframe
  - paragraph: Answers use local policy retrieval and Groq generation. Questions and relevant policy excerpts are sent to Groq.
  - link "Built with Gradio logo":
    - /url: https://gradio.app
    - text: Built with Gradio
    - img "logo"
  - generic: ·
  - button "Settings Settings":
    - text: Settings
    - img "Settings"
